Author: ShaalaXIV
Name: Synastry
Description: A Penumbra animation launcher for organizing, pairing, and synchronizing multi-actor animations.
Changelog: Fixes animations that Penumbra rejected because of outdated or space-padded option names, explains any remaining Penumbra refusal, gives uncategorized locked emotes a replacement carrier, protects your animation from nearby players and chair walk-ins, and starts unset mod options from the mod's defaults.
